definitions: The quality of being fair and impartial.
The value of the shares issued by a company.
The value of a property after all debts have been paid.

A system of law originating in England and existing in some other common law countries, that is based on natural justice and fairness and is intended to supplement and remedy the defects of the common law.
examples: The company is committed to equity in the workplace.
He sold his equity in the business.
They have built up significant equity in their home.
The case was heard in a court of equity.
